description: Fast delivery-queue list for ONE workspace (the user's current one unless workspace_id is given). Use for scheduled, failed, and published post facts.

limit.description: Maximum posts to return, capped by the API.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to read. Omit for the user's CURRENT workspace — other workspaces are NOT included. To reach another one, get its id from autowhisper_status.
